inputs.name: chatEnabled
inputs.label: Enable from Ask Promptly chat
inputs.helpText: Only enabled, published workflows can be selected from chat. Every chat run still requires approval.

inputs.name: invocationKey
inputs.label: Invocation key
inputs.validationMessage: Start with a lowercase letter and use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.

inputs.name: description
inputs.label: When should chat use this workflow?
inputs.placeholder: Read the configured customer sheet, filter rows by a requested status, and email each matching person.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.label: Parameters the AI may fill
inputs.helpText: Use simple fields for common requests. The AI fills these from the user message and asks when required information is missing.

inputs.name: parameterSchema
inputs.label: Advanced parameter JSON Schema
inputs.helpText: Optional. A non-empty flat object schema overrides the parameter editor. It must use additionalProperties: false.

outputs.name: triggerData
outputs.label: Full Payload
outputs.description: The entire payload passed by the agent.

outputs.name: message
outputs.label: User Message
outputs.description: The message from the user that triggered this workflow.

outputs.name: sessionId
outputs.label: Chat Session ID
outputs.description: The chat session that triggered this workflow.

outputs.name: parameters
outputs.label: AI Parameters
outputs.description: Validated parameters extracted from the user message.

outputs.name: invocationKey
outputs.label: Invocation Key
outputs.description: The chat workflow key selected by AI.

outputs.name: invocationId
outputs.label: Invocation ID
outputs.description: Unique ID for this approved chat invocation.
